context: Coinbase now publishes a live cbXRP reserve/supply page with 20 XRPL reserve addresses and a Base supply figure, while separate disclosures mark XRP and cbXRP held/commercially engaged.
decisions: Store Coinbase's cbXRP reserve and Base supply as a distinct wrapped-asset collateral series, separate from Coinbase corporate XRP holdings, institutional customer custody and exchange customer balances.

Use the 151,405,263.6 XRP reserve and 151,403,016.069 cbXRP supply as first-party published totals; compute 100.001484% coverage and 2,247.531 XRP surplus, but label as Coinbase-reported and not independently audited.

Retain the 20 published reserve addresses and exact displayed balances; the sum reconciles within 0.002 XRP. Track address-level balances and aggregate supply over time, preserving provider display timestamp and timezone ambiguity.

Do not treat cbXRP supply as net new XRP demand or a price signal. It represents XRP held to back wrapped supply; measure mint/burn and DeFi collateral utilization before inferring net lockup or demand.
Use Coinbase's 31 March 2026 disclosure only as a dated categorical statement that XRP/cbXRP are held and commercially engaged; do not infer current amount or specific trading activity.
Keep regional cbXRP restrictions separate from native XRP support; Coinbase help lists Japan and New York State among cbXRP send/receive restrictions.

Exact address comparison shows no overlap between Coinbase's 20 cbXRP reserve addresses and the five Binance incident source addresses; this does not establish broader ownership or infrastructure separation.
invariants: cbXRP is a Base wrapped asset backed by XRP held by Coinbase; it is not native XRP.
First-party proof-of-reserves display is not an independent audit; Base contract supply was not independently read because BaseScan returned 403.
Coinbase commercial engagement is broadly defined and holdings disclosure is dated 31 March 2026.
No cbXRP reserve metric is admitted as a price-prediction feature without validated temporal and causal analysis.
